SELECT seq_product_option.nextval FROM dual
INSERT INTO product_option ( product_option_no, product_no, option_size, color, stock, use_yn ) VALUES ( #{productOptionNo}, #{productNo}, #{optionSize}, #{color}, #{stock}, #{useYn} )
mapper.select: SELECT product_option_no AS productOptionNo, product_no AS productNo, option_size AS optionSize, color, stock FROM product_option WHERE product_no = #{productNo}

SELECT po.product_option_no AS "productOptionNo", p.product_no AS "productNo", p.name AS "productName", po.option_size AS "optionSize", po.color AS "color", CASE WHEN NVL(p.discount_rate, 0) > 0 THEN TRUNC((p.price * (100 - p.discount_rate) / 100) / 100) * 100 ELSE p.price END AS "salePrice", p.use_yn AS "productUseYn", po.use_yn AS "optionUseYn", po.stock AS "stock" FROM product_option po JOIN product p ON po.product_no = p.product_no WHERE po.product_option_no = #{productOptionNo}
mapper.update: update product_option set stock = stock + #{refundQuantity} where product_option_no = #{productOptionNo}
